mapper.select: SELECT lr.id, lr.user_id, lr.video_id, lr.comment_id, lr.type, v.id AS v_id, v.user_id AS v_user_id, v.video_url AS v_video_url, v.cover_url AS v_cover_url, v.title AS v_title, v.description AS v_description, v.visit_count AS v_visit_count, v.like_count AS v_like_count, v.comment_count AS v_comment_count, v.created_at AS v_created_at, v.updated_at AS v_updated_at, v.deleted_at AS v_deleted_at FROM `like_record` lr LEFT JOIN `video` v ON lr.video_id = v.id AND v.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE lr.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY lr.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
